definition: Frame separates subjects, considerations, contents, attitudes and supplied preference alternatives. about/believe preserve the content of a belief attitude. Reason is the unchanged thin subject/content relation; CountsAsReason adds an independently attributed consideration/attitude relation. ConsiderationPresentation explicitly relates their arities. EpistemicRole requires assessability, relevant applicability and favorable epistemic bearing; OrdinaryInstance additionally requires attributed reason status. IndependentInstance adds force across every supplied preference alternative. ActualPreference is supplied, so that universal includes the actual coordinate. produces, rewards, favors, Holds and force are independently interpreted inputs; no normative warrant is derived from psychological influence or numerical accuracy. Four pointwise calibration propositions compare reason attribution with ordinary role, independent role, bare production and bare reward. NamedDefinitionCoverage is an open disjunction of those propositions; RemainingDefinition negates each. Calibrations can overlap. Here favors means better epistemic support under the selected answer/warrant standard; force means the consideration counts pro tanto in favor of taking the attitude for the subject with that preference, even if other reasons can outweigh it. Actual application of these independently interpreted normative relations remains open.
note: Analyst interpretation fork under owner direction2026-11-06. The count/reassurance illustration and strongest goal-relative/naturalistic rivals are in docs/notes/epistemic-reasons-preconditions.md. A count may favor without producing belief; reassurance may produce/reward without favorable bearing; a compatible interpretation has coextensive production, reward, role and force criteria. None establishes actual warrant, irreducibility or categorical duty. Preference alternatives are the supplied comparison class, not a census of actual psychological/metaphysical possibilities. Favors and force remain explicit semantic/normative commitments, not opaque flags advertised as independently proved truths. All actual-instance/calibration/coverage premises remain separate from thin F6 approval.
